expectations.evidence: 'timeout.reconciliation.jitter default 60s -> raise proportionally (e.g. 120s-300s) so 5,000 apps don't align their polls'

evals.name: Monorepo commit invalidates cache for unrelated apps

expectations.text: Identifies that the manifest cache is keyed on commit SHA, so any commit invalidates the cache for every Application in the repo regardless of which paths changed
expectations.evidence: 'The cache key derives from the commit SHA. A new commit produces a new SHA, so every Application on that repo misses cache regardless of TTL.'

expectations.text: Recommends the argocd.argoproj.io/manifest-generate-paths annotation, scoped to each Application's own subdirectory, as the actual fix
expectations.evidence: 'argocd.argoproj.io/manifest-generate-paths: ".;charts/shared"'; '"." resolves relative to spec.source.path ... this app's own directory'

expectations.text: Explains this works without configuring Git webhooks (available since Argo CD v2.11)
expectations.evidence: 'Webhooks are not required. It has worked without them since Argo CD v2.11.'

expectations.text: Explicitly validates that lowering ARGOCD_REPO_CACHE_EXPIRATION was the wrong lever and explains why it made things worse
expectations.evidence: 'why lowering ARGOCD_REPO_CACHE_EXPIRATION made it worse ... forces re-renders for apps that would otherwise have served a valid cache. Put it back to 24h.'

expectations.text: Notes the annotation requires a full-history clone (no shallow clone depth set) to compare revisions
expectations.evidence: 'Requires a full-history clone. Do not set shallow-clone depth on this repository'

expectations.text: Mentions pairing it with resource.ignoreResourceUpdatesEnabled as defense in depth given known cache-coherency bugs in this feature
expectations.evidence: 'It has had real cache-coherency bugs ... Pair it with resource.ignoreResourceUpdatesEnabled ... as defense in depth'

evals.name: Shard rebalancing without restarts requested

expectations.evidence: 'requires running the controller as a Deployment, not a StatefulSet, plus ARGOCD_ENABLE_DYNAMIC_CLUSTER_DISTRIBUTION: "true" ... coordinates shard assignment through the argocd-app-controller-shard-cm ConfigMap'
